items.title: 5.4 Wire ka Young's modulus tay karna (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 5.4 with Fig. 5.4 (PDF 97-98).

blocks.text: Tajurbati taur par wire ki shakal mein material ke Young's modulus ki miqdar Searle ke apparatus se mil sakti hai (Fig. 5.4). Yeh do wires par mushtamil hai, ek auxiliary ya reference wire aur ek test (tajurbati) wire, barabar lambai aur ek hi material aur diameter ki, jo sakht sahare se lagi hain. Dono wires doosre siron par ufqi salakhon (frames F1 aur F2) se juri hain. Reference wire ki ufqi salakh ke hook par mustaqil wazan aur test wire par hanger latkaya jata hai, taake wire khinchi aur bal se paak rahe.

blocks.alt: Ek support se do taar latakte hain: baen taraf reference taar CD aur daen taraf test taar AB. Har ek par lakri ka frame hai, baen F2 aur daen F1, jo cross bars se jure hain. Frames ke darmiyan spirit level F1 par lage micrometer screw par tika hai. Frames ke neeche hooks par baen taraf constant weight slab aur daen taraf slotted weights wala bhari hanger latakta hai.
blocks.caption: Figure 5.4: Searle ka apparatus (kitab ki Figure 5.4 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

items: Metre scale se wire ki ibtidai lambai L0 napein.
Screw gauge se wire ka diameter d napein; wire ke kai mukhtalif nuqton par nap kar ausat lein.
Micrometer ghuma kar spirit level ko ufqi halat mein layein; micrometer ki reading reference reading ke taur par likhein.
Test wire par mazeed wazan dalein; test wire ke lambe hone se spirit level jhuk jata hai.
Micrometer screw ghuma kar spirit level ko dobara ufqi halat mein layein; doosri micrometer reading mein se pehli nikal kar test wire ki extension hasil karein.
Stress aur strain nikalein: stress = wazan / wire ka raqba = F / A = mg / (pi r^2); strain = delta L / L0 = lambai ki tabdeeli / asal lambai.
Test wire par wazan barha kar oopar ke qadam dohrayein taake stress aur strain ki mazeed qeematein milein.
Yeh qeematein stress-strain graph par banayein; yeh seedhi lakeer honi chahiye. Slope Y tay karein; slope wire ke Young's modulus ke barabar hai.

blocks.prompt: Ek hi material ki do wires kyun istemal hoti hain, aur extension wire ki lambai seedhi napne ke bajaye micrometer se kyun li jati hai?
blocks.explanation: Reference wire par test wire jaisa thermal expansion aur sahare ka jhukao hota hai, to dono ka muqabla un asraat ko kaat deta hai aur sirf dale wazan ki extension bachti hai. Extension millimetre ka hissa hai, metre scale ki pehchan se kahin kam, jabke micrometer 0.01 mm tak parhta hai.

items: Searle ka apparatus: sakht sahare par ek material aur diameter ki reference aur test wires, spirit level aur micrometer wale frames. L0 (metre scale) aur d (screw gauge, ausat) napein; seedha karein aur parhein; wazan dalein, dobara seedha karein, parhein: extension; stress = mg/(pi r^2), strain = delta L/L0; dohrayein; stress-strain lakeer ka slope = Y.
